review.posthog_relevance: Adds diagnostic capability to the HogQL query execution path, allowing PostHog engineers to distinguish between different reasons why metric precomputation was skipped, rather than just recording a generic skip. This aids in debugging query performance and correctness.

It replaces a boolean return with a specific reason string and propagates this reason into query tags. This represents a substantive, bounded improvement in diagnostics and observability for the query execution path.

observations.behavior: Adds a new optional field to the QueryTags model to record why metric-events precompute was skipped.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows query logging and diagnostics to distinguish between different reasons why a metric could not use the precomputed metric-events path, rather than just recording that it was skipped.

observations.behavior: Replaces boolean return values with specific skip reason strings and adds a helper method to retrieve the reason.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the query runner to return a human-readable reason for skipping metric-events precompute, rather than a boolean, and exposes this reason for use in query tagging.
